citations.claim: energy exceeds bound at first violating step 138
pre-impact speed near initial value showing no prior gain
post-bounce speed jumps well above impact speed despite e=1

counterfactual.change: Changed body e from 1 to 0 (single field); inelastic bounce removes energy injection and scenario passes with same steps.

explanation: Single body with e=1 and high horizontal speed hits the right arena boundary around step 138. Restitution 1 should preserve speed, but speed grows from ~43.89 to ~49.07 and total energy grows from ~1054 J to ~1294 J with zero controller work. Likely cause: boundary-wall impulse plus positional correction adds energy on a deep high-speed penetration in one dt (2 substeps), e.g. reflecting velocity then pushing the centre out along the normal while retaining/adding the correction to kinetic energy.
vision_note: A single blue circle approaches and stays in contact with the upper right arena boundary through steps 135 to 138. No tunneling, escape, or large positional jump is visible; the body remains pinned at the wall at the violating step.
